results.title: UN hails Nigeria-Morocco gas pipeline project as booster of Africa’s energy security
results.snippet:
The Nigeria–Morocco gas pipeline, also known as the African Atlantic Gas Pipeline (AAGP), is a strategic project jointly initiated by Nigeria and Morocco in 2016.

The project is designed to transport Nigerian natural gas through West African countries to Morocco, with the possibility of extending supplies to European markets.
